questions.question: ______ script resides on server computer.

server_only.explanation: Server-side scripts execute on the remote host server before returning plain output to the client browser.

questions.question: ______ statement is used to jump out of loop.

server_only.explanation: The 'break' keyword immediately terminates the enclosing loop or switch construct.

questions.question: ______ defines logical structure of document.

server_only.explanation: DOM represents HTML documents as an object hierarchy allowing programmatic manipulation.

questions.question: ______ property of window object returns Boolean value indicating whether window is closed or not.

server_only.explanation: The window.closed property evaluates to true if the designated window reference is shut.

questions.question: ______ event occurs when an element loses its focus.

server_only.explanation: The onblur event fires when focus leaves an active element.

questions.question: The ______ method in JavaScript is used to register an event handler on a specified element without overwriting existing handlers.

server_only.explanation: addEventListener() attaches an event handler without overriding existing event handlers.

questions.question: The ______ property of String object returns the total number of characters in a string.

server_only.explanation: The length property stores the total character count of a JavaScript string.

questions.question: JavaScript is case sensitive language.

server_only.explanation: JavaScript strictly distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase characters in variables, function names, and keywords.

questions.question: Math.ceil() function is used to return the nearest integer less than or equal to given number.

server_only.explanation: Math.ceil() rounds up to the next highest integer; Math.floor() returns the integer less than or equal to the number.

questions.question: MAX_VALUE property of number object returns smallest possible value.

server_only.explanation: Number.MAX_VALUE returns the highest representable numeric value, whereas Number.MIN_VALUE returns the lowest positive value.

questions.question: getDay() method of Date object returns month in number.

server_only.explanation: getDay() returns the day of the week (0 to 6). getMonth() returns the month index (0 to 11).

questions.question: onKeydown event occurs when user moves mouse pointer.

server_only.explanation: onkeydown is triggered by a keypress on the physical keyboard. Mouse movement triggers onmousemove.

questions.question: The getElementById() method returns a collection of multiple elements that share the same tag name.

server_only.explanation: getElementById() returns exactly one unique element matching the specified ID.

questions.question: The toLowerCase() method alters the original string in place without returning a new string.

server_only.explanation: JavaScript strings are immutable; methods like toLowerCase() return a new transformed string.

questions.question: JavaScript is ______ language.

server_only.explanation: Under the Maharashtra State Board syllabus definition, JavaScript is characterized as an interpreted client-side scripting language.

questions.question: Select correct method name of String object ______.

server_only.explanation: charAt(index) returns the character stored at the specified zero-based index of a string.

questions.question: ______ method displays message box with Ok and Cancel button.

server_only.explanation: window.confirm() produces a modal dialog with OK and Cancel buttons, returning true or false.

questions.question: We can declare all types of variables using keyword ______.

server_only.explanation: The 'var' keyword historically declares dynamically typed variables in standard JavaScript.

questions.question: Trace output of following JavaScript code: var str="Information Technology"; document.write(str.lastIndexOf("o"));

server_only.explanation: Indices in JavaScript strings are zero-based (0 to length - 1). In the string 'Information Technology', the character 'o' appears at index 3, 11, and last at index 19. Hence, lastIndexOf('o') returns 19.

questions.question: What is the trace output of following JavaScript statement: document.write("10" + 20);

server_only.explanation: When one operand is a string, the + operator concatenates both values, producing '1020'.

questions.question: Which TWO properties belong to the JavaScript 'window' object?

server_only.explanation: The global Window object directly contains the 'document' and 'location' properties.

questions.question: Which TWO methods are used to convert values to numeric types in JavaScript?

server_only.explanation: parseInt() and parseFloat() are native global methods used to convert string inputs into numbers.

questions.question: Which TWO methods belong to the browser 'history' object in JavaScript?

server_only.explanation: The history object controls session navigation through back(), forward(), and go().

questions.question: JavaScript features are ______, ______ and ______.
options: can handle date and time effectively

server_only.explanation: JavaScript is platform-independent, case-sensitive, supports event handling, has built-in objects, and can handle dates/times.

questions.question: Which THREE of the following are valid Math object methods in JavaScript?

server_only.explanation: Math.ceil(), Math.floor(), and Math.round() are built-in methods of JavaScript's Math object.

questions.question: Which THREE of the following are valid dialog box methods of the window object?

server_only.explanation: window.alert(), window.confirm(), and window.prompt() are standard interactive dialog boxes.

questions.question: Match the JavaScript function or method in Column A with its correct description in Column B.

answer.column_b: Returns next integer greater than or equal to given number
Returns the next integer less than or equal to given number
Writes HTML expression or JavaScript code to a document
Removes white spaces from both sides of string

server_only.explanation: Correct built-in methods of Math, Document, and String objects.
